.²1 To approach, come near, arrive at, reach (a place, person <ab>&c.</ab>); {#paramaM#}
 {#sAByamupEti#} <ls>Muṇḍ. 3. 1. 3</ls>. {#latAmupetya#} <ls>Ś. 1</ls>; so {#rAjAnam#},
 {#durgam#} <ab>&c.</ab> {#yogI paraM sTAnamupEti cAdyam#} <ls>Bg. 8. 28</ls>, <ls n="Bg.">10. 15</ls>, <ls n="Bg.">9. 28</ls>.
.²2 To go to (a master), become a pupil. {#upetya papracCa#} <ls>Praśna. Up. 1. 2</ls>, <ls n="Praśna. Up.">6. 1</ls>.
.²3 To have intercourse with (a woman), cohabit; {#vAcyaScAnupayan patiH#} <ls>Ms. 9. 4</ls>.
.²4 To under go, perform, undertake, practise; {#tapaH, satram#} <ab>&c.</ab>
.²5 To go to or pass into any state; {#yogam#} <ls>R. 16. 84</ls>; {#Bedam#} <ls>Ku. 2. 4</ls>;
 to fall into (misfortune <ab>&c.</ab>); {#kzayam, matyum, suKam, duHKam, nidrAm#} <ab>&c.</ab>
.²6 To obtain, attain to; {#tasya priyA jYAtayaH sukftamupayanti#} <ls>Kauṣ. Up. 1. 1</ls>;
 {#upEti SasyaM pariRAmaramyatAm#} <ls>Ki. 4. 22</ls>.
.²7 To incur, be present at.
.²8 To fall to oneʼs lot or share, befall; {#udyoginaM puruzasiMhamupEti#}
 {#lakzmIH#} <ls>Pt. 1. 361</ls>; <ls>Bg. 6. 27</ls>.
